title: Brand
description: A name printed on products; not a company. One per file, at brands/<first letter>/<id>.yaml.

id.description: Stable slug, prefix b_. Also the filename.

name.description: The brand name as it is normally written.

aliases.description: Other spellings seen in use, including local-language forms.

brand_owner.description: The entity that owns the trademark.

sources.description: At least one URL or register citation (<country>/<register>: <identifier>). Label text alone is not enough.

notes.description: Optional, 1-2 sentences. Only for a fact that stops the next editor making a wrong change the validator cannot catch.

verified_on.description: ISO 8601 date on which a person last checked this record against its sources.

example.description: true if this file is a template rather than curated data.
